goals.title: Ramble skill and intent path
goals.goal: Build the ramble skill (conversation contract, five routes, RCP v1 outbox format) and the sync step that turns flushed batches into dispatchd orders for the monitor.
goals.done_when: skill merged; RCP validator merged in the chitra repo; a live flushed batch lands as a dispatchd order and the monitor's decision appears in the decision log; research route ships disabled until the dispatchd retry fix is applied on twinridge

goals.scope: skill + outbox + validator + monitor doctrine paragraphs; boardd is a separate lane
goals.now: conversation-contract simulation running with the operator; findings feed the skill draft

goals.title: boardd live fleet dashboard
goals.goal: Build boardd: a tailnet web dashboard reading the chitra state dir, pushing per-change updates, translating agent updates to plain technical English at render time.

goals.hold_reason: awaiting operator acceptance of the v3 visual mockups and go on the build plan
goals.now: v3 mockups published with Linear and Vercel derived visual language
